protocol: Read-only upstream parameter-group gradient audit. The frozen M95 checkpoint is run with gradients enabled on the 284-bank diagnostic manifest. Oracle-selection CE and oracle-mask BCE+Dice gradients are compared in top-level parameter groups. No training or mechanism admission follows.
limitation: The audit measures local parameter-gradient alignment on one frozen checkpoint and one validation-derived manifest. It does not establish full-model causality, training efficacy, or primary-source novelty.
